# Draft Zenith

> A premium modern publishing company for book discovery, indie author promotion, and editorial essays on writing, reading, and the craft of storytelling.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured essays, trending books, curated collections, and editor spotlights.
- [The Journal](/blog): Long-form essays, reviews, and craft notes from Draft Zenith editors.
- [Authors](/authors): Profiles of indie authors, editors, and contributors.
- [Services](/services): Book promotion, Pinterest marketing, author spotlights, and visibility campaigns.
- [Submit](/submit): Submit a book to our editors for spotlight consideration.
- [About](/about): The story, mission, and values behind Draft Zenith.
